key_provisions_or_claims: €2.22bn over five years for AI, including €1.5bn public funding and €506M private co-financing
More than half of public funds go to AI training and talent, with targets for additional students and PhDs per year
Objectives: make France a leader in embedded, frugal and trustworthy AI
Accelerate diffusion of responsible AI systems across the economy
Governance by the SGPI with a public-private ecosystem partnership and a unified international AI brand (€5M)
annotation.summary_en: Press kit for the second phase of France's National AI Strategy (2021-2025), under France 2030. It commits €2.22bn, mostly to AI training and talent, to make France a leader in embedded, frugal and trustworthy AI and to speed AI diffusion in the economy. Governance is coordinated by the SGPI.
